pivHint: The tree sends out its ROOTs by the stream, Jeremiah writes. A painful dental procedure is called a root ______.
winText: You found it. ROOT isn't just a word in today's verse — a painful dental procedure is a root CANAL.
lossText: The word was CANAL. ROOT was the pivot — a painful dental procedure is a root CANAL.
votdVerse: “But blessed is the one who trusts in the Lord, whose confidence is in him.
passageText: “But blessed is the one who trusts in the Lord, whose confidence is in him. They will be like a tree planted by the water that sends out its roots by the stream. It does not fear when heat comes; its leaves are always green. It has no worries in a year of drought and never fails to bear fruit.”
